acquisition method: A data-dependent procedure that alternated between one MS scan followed by 20 MS/MS scans with 15.0 s dynamic exclusion.
cleavage agent: Trypsin/P was specified as cleavage enzyme allowing up to 4 missing cleavages.
collision energy: Peptides were then selected for MS/MS using NCE setting as 28
enrichment method: Immunoprecipitation was performed using anti-Flag antibody (Genescript, A00187-100) at 4 °C overnight.
instrument: tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in Q ExactiveTM Plus (Thermo) coupled online to the UPLC.
ionization type: The peptides were subjected to NSI source followed by tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS)
labeling: The resulting MS/MS data were processed using Maxquant search engine (v.1.5.2.8).
mass analyzer: fragments were detected in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 17,500.
precursor tolerance: 20 ppm in First search and 5 ppm in Main search
The mass tolerance for precursor ions was set as 20 ppm in First search and 5 ppm in Main search
fragment tolerance: the mass tolerance for fragment ions was set as 0.02 Da.
ptm: Carbamidomethyl on Cys (fixed); acetylation modification (variable); oxidation on Met (variable)
Carbamidomethyl on Cys was specified as fixed modification and acetylation modification and oxidation on Met were specified as variable modifications.
